narrative.northStar: A photographic guide with Liquid Glass navigation
narrative.overview: Cool readable surfaces and natural autumn photographs connect every sightseeing stop to sourced transport, costs, tips, and its itinerary date.
keyCharacteristics: Translucent navigation with solid readable content panels
System light and dark themes with reduced-transparency fallbacks
One guide per sightseeing stop with shared park costs clearly identified
Geist typography and locally hosted destination photographs
rules: The CSS tokens in src/style.css are authoritative.
Keep the original 14 dates and 13 overnight bases.
Never claim a photo is newer or more location-specific than its source proves.
dos: Keep visible focus and native dialog behavior.
Link published prices to their sources.
donts: Do not use glass inside glass.
Do not autoplay or animate distortion.
Do not count shared park tickets once per stop.
